signature: Container killed by YARN for exceeding memory limits
diagnostic_steps: Run `sparkforge analyze event-log` on executor event log
Inspect physical plan for broadcast vs sort-merge join
fixes: Increase worker type from G.1X to G.2X or adjust spark.executor.memoryOverhead
Apply salting to skewed join key
Use broadcast join hint only on verified small tables (<10MB)
unsafe_fixes: Setting spark.sql.shuffle.partitions to an arbitrary high number without checking memory
verification: Re-run job with functional validation plan and measure peak memory in event log
